name: prod-tripwire
description: A red PROD band above the prompt while a command touches production, then a dim note of the last prod touch until the next prompt.

patterns.title: Your prod patterns
patterns.description: label=regex entries separated by ;; (e.g. prod DB=psql .*prod-db;;site=example\.com). Checked before the built-in ones: db:migrate:prod, neonctl, Vercel --prod, gh pr merge
